reason: A proposes a physically plausible high-temperature intervention: a compositionally complex oxide can tune oxygen mobility and stabilize dispersed PGM sites against sintering, although its cited evidence is indirect and the experiment should explicitly compare reduced PGM loading against a higher-loading commercial baseline. B is fundamentally undermined because melamine is unlikely to survive 200–500 °C oxidizing exhaust, and its fuel-cell evidence does not support the claimed exhaust-catalyst mechanism.
